raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: uxsim
  version: "1.13.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/uxsim-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2a622eca69743741a6169058eb1585a51215896d2ba187bf6e507c1cf640ba5d

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=63.0
    - wheel
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.21.5
    - matplotlib-base >=3.5.2
    - pillow >=9.2.0
    - tqdm >=4.64.1
    - scipy >=1.9.1
    - pandas >=1.4.4
    - pyqt >=5.15.7
    - dill >=0.3.9
    - networkx >=3.2.1

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - uxsim
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  summary: Vehicular traffic flow simulator in road network, written in pure Python
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/toruseo/UXsim
  documentation: https://toruseo.jp/UXsim/docs/index.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
